proofType: Frontend rejection of captured unsafe upstream/cached shopping rows. All API calls and images are intercepted; no live supplier, local-shop, account or image-generation proof.
fixtureNote: Captured product identities, prices, pack quantities and eligibility are retained. Timestamps are refreshed only to avoid testing staleness, and every unsafe candidate is deliberately injected as chosen. Rice and positive controls are synthetic, explicitly labelled fixtures.

fixtureCases.issue: Explicit turkey request automatically selected duck breast fillets.
